subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `openclaw notify` admin broadcast surface now, fold shell-originated UI alerts into the broader Control UI notification architecture, or keep direct alerts on existing plugin/channel/Web Push paths?
rationale: The capability is still missing, but it changes core CLI, Gateway authorization, broadcast targeting, and UI interruption semantics, so automation cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Design Core Notify Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical shell/admin connected-UI notification feature and require an explicit Gateway event/RPC contract before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Broader UI Notifications
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 own the generic notification queue and keep this issue as the shell/admin input requirement until that tracker covers it explicitly.

options.title: Prefer Existing External Paths
options.body: Reject a core in-app broadcast command and document the supported `message send`, Web Push, plugin, or channel workaround for external alerts.

recommendation.title: Design Core Notify Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical shell/admin connected-UI notification feature and require an explicit Gateway event/RPC contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent product-boundary discussion on direct notification delivery and Gateway/CLI history adjacent to the requested surface.
